title: The Paint Behind Our Finish — Why We Use Glasurit 100 Line
excerpt: A look at the premium paint system we use for European vehicle refinishing, and why it delivers a factory-quality finish every time.
body:
When you collect your vehicle after a repair, the finish needs to be indistinguishable from factory. That's not just about skill — it's about the materials. At Eurotech, we use the Glasurit 100 Line, a premium automotive basecoat system from BASF that's trusted by manufacturers and leading body shops worldwide.

Precision Colour Matching

One of the biggest challenges in vehicle refinishing is getting the colour exactly right. European manufacturers use complex paint formulations — metallic finishes, pearlescent coats, tricoat systems — that are difficult to replicate with generic products.

Glasurit addresses this with the world's most comprehensive colour database and a fully digital colour matching process. With over 90 tinting bases and mixing clears, the system achieves what Glasurit calls 100% colour accuracy. For our customers, that means no visible difference between the repaired panel and the rest of the vehicle.

Lower Environmental Impact

The 100 Line keeps VOC (volatile organic compound) levels under 250 grams per litre — 40% below the legal limit, regardless of temperature conditions. This is independently verified through the ECOcert100 programme, certified by TÜV Süd.

The system also uses around 30% less material than conventional alternatives, and a new Multi-Purpose-Tintable product allows leftover mixes to be reused, cutting consumption by a further 20%.

Faster, More Efficient Repairs

Beyond quality and sustainability, the 100 Line delivers up to 40% shorter process times. Tricoat repairs that traditionally require three stages can be completed in two. This has been validated across more than 1,000 body shops in 20 countries.

For our customers, faster process times mean shorter repair turnarounds without any compromise on quality.

Why It Matters

Choosing the right paint system is as important as choosing the right repairer. At Eurotech, we pair factory-authorized repair methods with factory-grade materials. The Glasurit 100 Line is a key part of delivering the standard our customers expect from a premium European vehicle specialist.
